title: Sum over a range
statement: For every function $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and every $V\in\mathbb{N}$, the sum of the list $f(0),f(1),\ldots,f(V-1)$ equals the finite sum $\sum_{i=0}^{V-1}f(i)$.
